title: Developer - ML Specialty
description: Machine learning with Pentaho Data Integration. A credit-card fraud-detection use case covering H2O AutoML, supervised learning with an H2O GBM in Python, and handling imbalanced datasets.

assistant.subject: machine learning pipelines in PDI (AutoML with H2O, model training and scoring in Python Executor steps, and fraud-detection workflows)
suggestions: How does the AutoML transformation hand data to H2O?
Where does the training step save the model, and how does predict find it?
What path goes in the Python Executor's virtual environment box?
Why does my Python Executor step fail to load the model?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and what the course needs: Python 3.11+ with H2O and JupyterLab in the h2o-env virtual environment, and optionally a Google account for Colab.

moduleSummaries.title: Machine Learning
moduleSummaries.summary: Detect credit-card fraud with Pentaho Data Integration: discover models automatically with H2O AutoML, learn fraud patterns with a supervised algorithm, and handle the imbalanced datasets that make fraud detection hard.

moduleSummaries.title: Capstone Project
moduleSummaries.summary: One project across the course: a nightly job that retrains an H2O fraud model behind a quality gate, scores the night's new orders with it, and writes a review queue at the fraud team's threshold.
